'''Bonekrusher Siegeknuckles''' is an [[Elite enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A Landbreaker combatant equipped with heavy explosive gauntlets. These serve as the mainstay of Bonekrusher mobs. A Siegeknuckles's gauntlets serve as portable weapons for taking down fortified positions.}}

==Overview==
One of the elite Bonekrushers, Bonekrusher Siegeknuckles are very mobile in attacks, and has several abilities that can really break the knuckles off:

*Enters a blocking state, during which attacks will cause the Siegeknuckles to gain ATK and scatter a piece of reactive armor scale around, up to 5 times. 
**The armor scales explode after a short period if an Operator comes near it, which deal Physical damage.
**If a battle skill hit the Siegeknuckles when all attempts are used up, he will immediately throws a swiping punch followed by a straight punch, dealing Physical damage and scatter 4 armor scales around, which is then followed by an explosion on the fist, dealing Physical damage and scatter 8 armor scales around.
*Throws two swiping punches, followed by another punch, dealing Physical damage.
*Rush towards the target before delivering a straight punch, followed by an explosion, dealing Physical damage and scatter 4 armor scales around. This ability can be interrupted by skills.
*Throws one swiping punch, followed by an upward swiping punch, lastly followed by an explosion and scatter 4 armor scales around, dealing Physical damage. This ability can be interrupted by skills.
*Throws two swiping punches, followed by a 360-degree swing, then lastly a straight punch followed by an explosion and scatter 4 armor scales around, dealing Physical damage, This ability can be interrupted by skills before the explosion.
*Pulls Operators toward self while retrieving armor scales that aren't triggered, then followed by a leap with a ground slam, dealing Physical damage. If armor scales are retrieved successfully, the attack is repeated once.
